label: INTERNAL REVIEW
travelingCohort: Prospective cohort: Esri event-delivery personnel and centrally coordinated GIS-user/customer delegations. Their participation and overnight travel are reasonable inferences from the five-day in-person program, not confirmed rosters or bookings. No specific customer employer delegation was verified.

timing.raw: Esri User Conference 2027 — staff and coordinated customer-cohort lodging qualification

demandSignal: Esri has announced a five-day, in-person corporate GIS-user program at the San Diego Convention Center for July 12–16, 2027. The account-level opportunity is to qualify Esri's own event-delivery personnel and any centrally coordinated customer/user delegations, rather than assume the entire conference represents an available hotel block.
whyWyndhamFits: Wyndham San Diego Bayside at 1355 North Harbor Drive offers the specified downtown bayfront location approximately one mile from the Convention Center and two miles from SAN. A separately coordinated staff or customer lodging block could fit its convention-adjacent role. Any proposed block would need qualification against the hotel's 30–250-room commercial planning band; no block size or inventory availability is established.
sourcingStatus: The reviewed 2027 announcement establishes dates, venue and an Esri event contact, but does not publish hotel selections, lodging commitments or a supplier RFP. Registration-notification availability is not evidence of open hotel sourcing.
recommendedFirstAction: Reach Brittany Jolly (brittanyjolly@esri.nl) regarding Esri lodging/meeting needs for Wyndham San Diego Bayside.
specificQuestion: Are you still evaluating downtown / bayfront lodging or meeting space for this cohort, and what peak room nights / dates should we check?
